frame: robot frame: origin on the floor midway between the wheel contact points, x forward, y left, yaw counter-clockwise from x; a hit at range r lands at (x_m + r cos yaw, y_m + r sin yaw)

front.placement: top shelf front, centre, level, facing forward

left.placement: lower shelf front, left, level, facing forward

right.placement: lower shelf front, right, level, facing forward

notes: mount: measured 2026-09-04 with a tape (+-1 cm). null would mean not measured: such a sensor feeds the reflex only. The VL53L1X sees a ~27 deg cone, so a level sensor at 0.16 m would reach the floor at ~0.67 m at the cone edge.
